title: Money values handled with Decimal and explicit rounding
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag Decimal(str(value)) as a stringly-typed smell or the repeated quantize calls as noise. Floats are rejected outright because binary floats cannot represent cents exactly; converting through str preserves the decimal the caller wrote; and every public result is quantized to cents with an explicit ROUND_HALF_UP mode so totals never depend on the process-wide decimal context.
